title: Logspace adjacency data
statement: A circuit family has logspace adjacency data if it has polynomial size, its size language is decidable in logspace, each of its gate type languages is decidable in logspace, and its edge language is decidable in logspace.
hypotheses_covered: The size language is in LOGSPACE
For every gate type, its type language is in LOGSPACE
The edge language is in LOGSPACE
